name_or_item: All British railways, maintenance and renewal of rolling stock

name_or_item: All British railways, maintenance and renewal of rolling stock, 1920-21 estimate
scope: as the 1913 row, estimated for the Rates Advisory Committee; includes 600000 for the Government pool arrangement

name_or_item: Government pool element inside the 1920-21 rolling-stock estimate
scope: a transfer for the Government pool arrangement, not repair work
notes: MEASURED (official estimate). Excluding it gives a real change of 1.126 rather than 1.143.

name_or_item: Real change in the rolling-stock maintenance head, 1913 to 1920-21
scope: nominal 40600000 divided by 13823094, deflated by 275/107
source_ref: derived from the two rolling-stock rows and New/config/prices.tab
notes: DERIVED. 1.126 excluding the pool item. The whole rolling-stock head rose only 14 per cent in real terms.

name_or_item: Carriage share of the rolling-stock maintenance head
scope: Hill's carriage and wagon levels at 1913 prices against the measured head; an arithmetic reconstruction, band 9-11
source_ref: derived from the 1913 head and Hill 1895 Appendix II Table II; https://archive.org/details/minutesproceedi43britgoog
notes: DERIVED. The reason a change in carriage maintenance is nearly invisible in the head: a doubling of carriage work moves the head by about 10 per cent.
